Cross-System Relationship Map

Purpose And Reading Guide

This map separates the shipped relationship families and their meanings from proposed Tag Semantic Tokens. Solid edges are verified current generation or consumption; dashed edges are proposed architecture only. Resolver Tokens are retired and therefore have no proposed flow.

Diagram

flowchart TB
    accTitle: Current cross-system relationship projections
    accDescr: Subject aboutness, semantic mentions, Tag document locations, live Project State reporting, Working-owned Copy Delete and Publish lineage, and Projects publication cues remain separate products with explicit authorities.

    subgraph subjects["Shipped: document subject aboutness"]
        direction TB
        sourceSubjects["Document front matter<br/>folder_path, work_id, or series_id"]

        aboutConsumers["Project State + coverage + public doc_url[]<br/>focused consumers"]
        sourceSubjects --> subjectProjection --> aboutConsumers

        catalogue --> targetLookup --> docsBuild --> rendered

        projectState["Project State producer"]
        projectResponse["Live v2 response"]

        projectFolders --> projectState
        projectEvidence --> projectState --> projectResponse --> projectReport
    end

    subgraph copyLineage["Shipped: Working-owned document lineage"]
        direction TB
        copyResult["Configured New/Replace Copy result<br/>exact Working and Editorial identities"]
        deleteResult["Confirmed document Delete<br/>exact Working or Editorial identities"]
        publishResult["Successful scope Publish<br/>exact current Editorial public files"]
        publicationLineage["Private Working-owned lineage table<br/>current Editorial children + published_url"]
        publicationCues["Projects<br/>highest Editorial or Published cue + exact child detail"]
        copyResult --> publicationLineage
        deleteResult --> publicationLineage

Relationship Meanings

  • A document subject says what the document is about. Project State placement, curator coverage, and public Work/Series doc_url[] use this exact declaration.
  • A semantic token says which Work or Series the document mentions or relates to in body content. Its usage index supports mapping and analysis, not aboutness or public document metadata.
  • Tag Registry doc_url[] is an authored Tag association. document-locations.json supplies public-safe titles and routes for selection but is not Tag authority.
  • Project State is a folder-centred live reconciliation. It observes canonical folders, Works, Series, and subjects without becoming a relationship database or mutation owner.
  • Publication lineage records the current Editorial children deliberately created or replaced from one exact current Working document and whether each currently has a public projection. Working Delete ends the complete record; Editorial Delete removes only that child after required public cleanup; Publish alone reconciles surviving published_url evidence. The table never infers identity or synchronizes content.
  • Insert subject link inserts one authored snapshot from the current subject. It does not create another relationship projection or make Project State a build prerequisite.

What This Does Not Include

  • inference from semantic mentions to document aboutness;
  • automatic Work-to-Series or Series-to-Work document association;
  • graph traversal, ranking, recursive expansion, or dependent-document rebuilds;
  • content comparison, diff, merge, or automatic New/Replace choice;
  • Project State detail rows based on project_subfolder;
  • delivery sequencing; or
  • the retired Resolver Token design, retained only as a historical record.

Possible Enhancements

  • Add Tag Semantic Tokens after their canonical association migration and target projection are delivered.
  • Add a separate semantic relationship-analysis map when usage-index consumers grow beyond the current report.

Authorities

Current implementation evidence includes docs-viewer/build/docs_builder/semantic_target_lookup.py, studio/services/tags/tag_source_model.py, studio/services/tags/tag_registry_mutations.py, docs-viewer/services/docs_document_location_projection.py, docs-viewer/services/docs_project_state.py, and docs-viewer/services/docs_document_publication_lineage.py; focused coverage includes docs-viewer/tests/python/test_semantic_target_lookup.py, studio/tests/python/test_tag_source_model.py, studio/tests/python/test_tag_registry_mutations.py, docs-viewer/tests/python/test_build_document_locations.py, docs-viewer/tests/python/test_docs_project_state.py, and docs-viewer/tests/python/test_docs_document_publication_lineage.py.
